problems_and_friction: Prior stages left clean, well-structured handoffs (PIPELINE-STATE.md with explicit carry-forwards), so synthesis was straightforward. Main friction: all pricing is knowledge-only with no web access, so the year-1 EUR figure had to be assembled from ballpark per-seat numbers and flagged at plus/minus 20 percent throughout. A pre-existing empty 'snapshots' subdirectory inside work/ got copied into the snapshot, which is harmless but slightly messy. The R5 carry-forward (Salesforce renewal cap) applied to a vendor I did not pick, so I translated it into a HubSpot renewal-uplift cap instead.
context_understood: I was the final decision maker in a 3-stage serial CRM-evaluation pipeline for Brightline (40-person Dublin ad agency), synthesizing market research and risk analysis into a single costed recommendation (HubSpot, ~EUR 40k year 1), a 3-phase rollout plan, and explicit weighing of the specialists.
